AeroPulse Privacy Commitment

1. Location Data: AeroPulse requests precise or approximate location strictly to query Open-Meteo air quality and weather forecasts for your current geographical area. Your location is processed in real time and is never transmitted to advertising trackers or stored on external servers.

2. On-Device Storage: Saved favorite spots and profile sensitivities are stored strictly on your local device using Android Room Database. No account creation or personal login is required.

3. Third-Party Data Sources: Meteorological, particulate matter (PM2.5, PM10, ozone), and botanical pollen forecasts are provided by the Open-Meteo Air Quality API. Planetary geomagnetic Kp-index telemetry is provided by NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center feeds.

4. Data Sharing & Analytics: We do not sell, rent, or monetize your personal information or movement traces.

5. Contact: For privacy questions or assistance, reach out via tuyenctbk@gmail.com.
